sentences.text: Det er mandag morgen. Klokka er sju.
sentences.english: It is Monday morning. It is seven o'clock.

sentences.text: Anna må gå til klinikken.
sentences.english: Anna has to go to the clinic.

sentences.text: Men Anna har ikke nøkkelen. Den er borte.
sentences.english: But Anna does not have the key. It is gone.

sentences.text: Hvor er nøkkelen? Jeg må finne den!
sentences.english: Where is the key? I have to find it!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg vet ikke, Anna. Har du den i vesken?
sentences.english: I do not know, Anna. Do you have it in the bag?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Nei, den er ikke i vesken. Den er borte!
sentences.english: No, it is not in the bag. It is gone!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Anna leter i stua. Den er ikke på bordet. Den er ikke under sengen.
sentences.english: Anna looks in the living room. It is not on the table. It is not under the bed.

sentences.text: Sam kommer inn.
sentences.english: Sam comes in.

sentences.text: Hei, Anna! Hva leter du etter?
sentences.english: Hi, Anna! What are you looking for?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg leter etter nøkkelen. Den er borte!
sentences.english: I am looking for the key. It is gone!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg kan hjelpe deg. Er den under bordet?
sentences.english: I can help you. Is it under the table?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Er den under sengen?
sentences.english: Is it under the bed?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Sam finner telefonen til Anna.
sentences.english: Sam finds Anna's phone.

sentences.text: Her er telefonen din. Men den er ikke her.
sentences.english: Here is your phone. But it is not here.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Takk, Sam! Telefonen er bra, men jeg må finne den.
sentences.english: Thanks, Sam! The phone is good, but I have to find it.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Nils kommer inn. Han går til skolen.
sentences.english: Nils comes in. He is going to school.

sentences.text: Hei! Hvor er den? Her er den!
sentences.english: Hi! Where is it? Here it is!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Den ligger i jakka di, Anna!
sentences.english: It is in your jacket, Anna!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: I jakka? Jeg har glemt den i jakka!
sentences.english: In the jacket? I have forgotten it in the jacket!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Du glemmer ofte mye, Anna.
sentences.english: You often forget a lot, Anna.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, jeg glemmer mye. Takk, Nils!
sentences.english: Yes, I forget a lot. Thanks, Nils!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Nå ligger den i vesken din.
sentences.english: Now it is in your bag.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, den ligger her. Nå går jeg. Ha det bra!
sentences.english: Yes, it is here. Now I am going. Goodbye!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ha det bra, Anna! Du er ofte trøtt, men du er glad.
sentences.english: Goodbye, Anna! You are often tired, but you are happy.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Anna går til bussen. Hun er glad. Det er bra!
sentences.english: Anna goes to the bus. She is happy. That is good!

sentences.text: Sam og Lars er hjemme og drikker te med melk.
sentences.english: Sam and Lars are at home. They drink tea with milk.

sentences.text: Vil du ha brød, Sam?
sentences.english: Do you want bread, Sam?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne. Jeg liker brød med ost.
sentences.english: Yes, please. I like bread with cheese.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Anna jobber mye. Hun er ofte trøtt.
sentences.english: Anna works a lot. She is often tired.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Ja, men hun er glad. Hun liker klinikken.
sentences.english: Yes, but she is happy. She likes the clinic.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: På søndag leser presten i bibelen. Alle ber og synger en sang. Gud elsker oss, og vi har det i hjertet.
sentences.english: On Sunday the pastor reads in the Bible. Everyone prays and sings a song. God loves us, and we have it in our hearts.

sentences.text: Det er vått ute i dag, men i morgen kommer sola. Det blir varmt.
sentences.english: It is wet outside today, but tomorrow the sun comes. It will be warm.

sentences.text: Sam besøker Anna og Lars. Han kan sitte i stua, og han får kaffe.
sentences.english: Sam visits Anna and Lars. He can sit in the living room, and he gets coffee.

sentences.text: På onsdag og fredag ber Sam om fred.
sentences.english: On Wednesday and Friday Sam prays for peace.
